tests_observed_in_output.name: start creates a playing arena with three lives and a wave
WASD moves the player and walls block movement
fire creates a friendly bullet and cooldown prevents instant spam
a bullet can destroy a destructible brick wall
pause stops updates and restart resets score, wave and run counters
clearing a wave advances and score increases
clearing wave 3 reaches victory and adds the final bonus
three deaths end the run instead of allowing a fourth
snapshot is serializable and reflects HUD fields
long mixed-input run keeps the simulation finite and bounded

requirement_coverage_check.移动: 用例 2：按 d 后 player.x 增大；x=2 时按 a 被左侧边界墙阻挡（x 不变）
requirement_coverage_check.射击冷却: 用例 3：开火后 shots>=1 且 cooldown>0；冷却内再开火被拒（shots 不变）；冷却结束后 shots+1
requirement_coverage_check.砖墙: 用例 4：友方子弹命中 brick 后 walls.length=0
requirement_coverage_check.暂停/重开: 用例 5：暂停期间 update 不推进 time；restart 后 status=playing，score/wave/kills/shots/time 归零、hp=3
requirement_coverage_check.波次: 用例 6：清波 wave+1、score=200、新敌人>=4；用例 7：清第 3 波 -> status=won、score=500
requirement_coverage_check.快照: 用例 9：snapshot 键集合恰为 enemies/hp/kills/lives/paused/score/status/time/wave，且可 JSON 序列化
requirement_coverage_check.额外守卫: 用例 8：三次死亡即 status=lost（不允许第四条命）；用例 10：长跑混合输入不抛错、状态有限
requirement_coverage_check.是否补最小断言: 未补。任务允许补一个最小缺失断言，但启动/移动/射击冷却/砖墙/暂停重开/波次/快照 7 个要求面均已被现有断言覆盖，按“不要为更全面生成大量新测试”的约束未新增测试
